name: Ferienwohnungen Rudigier
beschreibung:
Perched sunnily above Kappl in the Paznaun valley, Ferienwohnungen Rudigier offers restful accommodations for families and outdoor travellers, featuring private balconies with sweeping mountain views.

The Kappl cable cars and the nearby Silvretta Arena in Ischgl are quickly accessible for skiing in winter and hiking in summer.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnungen Rudigier in Kappl provides a sunny panoramic setting and modern holiday apartments in the Paznaun valley.
